reentry.parallel_current_selection_delta: research: fuse Trigger-2 statistical gate with renderer transportability

sequence: child runs under strace open/openat and loader opens local checkpoint pathnames
after child exit _compare_consumed_to_manifest reopens and hashes current local_dir/path contents
post-load _verify_manifest again hashes current local_dir paths
matching path-level observations currently permit consumed_identity_match=true

finding.claim: Observed pathname access plus hashes taken before and after the loader read interval does not prove the exact bytes actually consumed when the pathname is mutable. A transient replace/mutate-and-restore can in principle make the loader read nonmanifest bytes while later path hashes again match the admitted manifest.

hypothesis.H1: A scheduled transient shard swap after prehash and before/during loader access can evade the current v1 predicate if the original bytes are restored before the parent rehashes the pathname.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The source checkpoint tree is immutable for the whole load interval, making that schedule impossible.
hypothesis.counterassessment: V1 does not currently attest such immutability. Selection-grade identity must encode or measure it rather than assume it.
hypothesis.cheapest_discriminator: Build a deterministic source-level transient swap-and-restore regression around a fake shard/read consumer. The current v1 evidence model should be demonstrated insufficient without loading a real Qwen checkpoint.

design: copy each admitted manifest member into memfd while hashing and size-checking the copied bytes
apply and verify F_SEAL_WRITE, F_SEAL_GROW, F_SEAL_SHRINK and F_SEAL_SEAL before model load
build a private snapshot-shaped mirror whose manifest paths resolve to inherited sealed descriptors
run the loader against only that mirror; retain strace path observation for shard-selection completeness
derive consumed-byte identity from the pre-seal copied-byte hash plus verified irreversible seals, not from a mutable source pathname rehash after load
optionally reverify the original source tree after load as a provenance drift guard, never as the primary consumed-byte proof
successor_candidate.alternative: fs-verity on a supported explicitly attested filesystem
successor_candidate.resource_risk: A sealed in-memory mirror adds roughly checkpoint-size memory pressure and requires an explicit resource guard before full model execution.

qwen_loader_side_check.initial_concern: Qwen3.5 documentation often shows multimodal conditional-generation loading while v1 uses AutoModelForCausalLM.
qwen_loader_side_check.resolution: Current Transformers Qwen3.5 support intentionally permits AutoModelForCausalLM to unwrap the composite configuration to Qwen3_5ForCausalLM/Qwen3_5TextConfig for text-only loading; this is not presently the blocking source gap.
qwen_loader_side_check.implication: Do not redesign the loader solely because of the AutoClass difference; keep exact Transformers/runtime identity bound in receipts.

current_p0: preserve FreeSwarm HARD_OFF and do not execute provider/model experiments while runtime quiescence is unproven
do not spend the three-frozen-checkpoint runtime budget merely to generate v1 receipts that cannot prove selection-grade consumed bytes
implement or independently attest an immutable/read-time consumed-byte successor and add transient swap-and-restore regression
only after exact-source successor review plus then-current separately admitted FREE non-provider execution authority run BASE, POSTTRAINED and TARGET_MEASURED
feed only successor-eligible identity receipts into renderer transportability, matched evaluation and preregistered statistical selection gates
next_exact_action: Re-enter current main and authority. Close the consumed-byte TOCTOU boundary with a fail-closed ABI/v2 or equivalent immutable/read-time mechanism and a deterministic transient swap-and-restore regression before any three-candidate checkpoint execution or winner eligibility.
